title: About | Handoff
headline: Who we are
lead: Handoff places Latin America's top talent inside US companies, and stays with you after they're placed. The work is to match the right professional to your team and your culture, and to support them so they last.

gap.headline: Talent is everywhere. Opportunity isn't.
gap.body: Skilled professionals live everywhere. The chance to work with great companies doesn't reach all of them. Handoff closes that gap.

winWin.headline: A win on both sides

sides.title: For the companies we work with
sides.body: Many of our clients don't have the budget for every seat they need, so they get stuck and can't scale. With Handoff, they bring on the talent to grow, and to compete with bigger companies in their industry that have bigger budgets.

sides.title: For the professionals we place
sides.body: Our talent is paid above market, works with some of the best companies in the world, and keeps growing with upskilling from us.

winWin.closer: Hearing clients talk about how far they've scaled, and hearing the talent talk about what the role opened up for them, is why we do this.

founder.headline: The founder
founder.body: Our founder spent over a decade hiring in this industry before starting Handoff. That's why the recruiting runs deepest in corporate housing and relocation, and why the Hands-Off Hiring System is built the way it is, from years of doing the hiring firsthand.

items.name: Humanize
items.line: People come first in everything we do.

items.name: Connect
items.line: Relationships are the heart of our business.

close: We are the team behind your team. We do the sourcing, screening, and support, so you can bring on talent with confidence and keep your focus on the work.
